title: Unit-aware analysis reveals opposing donor and within-donor disease signals in human kidney single-cell data
description: Analysis code, curated derived tables, manuscript and figures for donor pseudobulk, Milo neighborhood, neighborhood-expression association, within-donor cell-rank, donor-stratified TAL signature transfer, NephQTL2 kidney eQTL context, GSE211785 snATAC context, composition-expression decomposition, independent non-KPMP validation, a prespecified 400-gene analysis-unit sensitivity panel, a reusable unitaware Python package, and effect-aware conditional-null calibration in human kidney thick ascending limb subtypes.
